messages.subject: [Rsiena-help] [rsiena-help][39676] Weighted Networks
messages.body_plain:
Dear Sally,

Sorry for the late reply. Actually, your type of question is more suitable for the Siena-Stocnet user group at http://groups.yahoo.com/groups/stocnet/

The answer to your question:
RSiena can handle networks with a small number of ordinal values. This is done by defining the cumulative networks (defined by "values at least r") as multiplex networks. A script for how to do this is given at the Siena scripts page,
http://www.stats.ox.ac.uk/~snijders/siena/siena_scripts.htm

This is a feature which has not yet been used a lot and there is no further documentation.

Best regards,
Tom

================================================================
Tom A.B. Snijders
Professor of Statistics in the Social Sciences
Department of Politics and Department of Statistics
Nuffield College
University of Oxford
tel. +44-01865-278599

By: Sally Macdonald

I just have a very simple question, could someone tell me if RSiena can only analysis binary networks or can it also handle weighted networks.


Many Thanks



Sally Macdonald

messages.subject: [Rsiena-help] error installing from matrix package
messages.body_plain:
Dear list,

I have a problem when installing RSiena on UBUNTU 13.04 with the root.

Here is the error massage. Something went wrong with the matrix package. 
Could you give me some advice to fix it please? The installation went 
well on windows.

<mailto:rsiena-help at lists.r-forge.r-project.org>lgfortran -lm -lquadmath 
-L/usr/lib/R/lib -lR
/usr/bin/ld: cannot find -llapack
/usr/bin/ld: cannot find -lblas
/usr/bin/ld: cannot find -lgfortran
collect2: error: ld returned 1 exit status
make: *** [Matrix.so] Error 1
ERROR: compilation failed for package 'Matrix'
* removing '/usr/local/lib/R/site-library/Matrix'
/usr/lib/R/bin/Rcmd: 50: /usr/lib/R/etc/Renviron: LANGUAGE: not found
ERROR: dependency 'Matrix' is not available for package 'RSiena'
* removing '/usr/local/lib/R/site-library/RSiena'

The downloaded source packages are in
     '/tmp/Rtmpsv9OtD/downloaded_packages'
Warning messages:
1: In install.packages("RSiena") :
   installation of package 'Matrix' had non-zero exit status
2: In install.packages("RSiena") :
   installation of package 'RSiena' had non-zero exit status

Similar error showed when I try to install Matrix package first.

lgfortran -lm -lquadmath -L/usr/lib/R/lib -lR
/usr/bin/ld: cannot find -llapack
/usr/bin/ld: cannot find -lblas
/usr/bin/ld: cannot find -lgfortran
collect2: error: ld returned 1 exit status
make: *** [Matrix.so] Error 1
ERROR: compilation failed for package 'Matrix'
* removing '/usr/local/lib/R/site-library/Matrix'

The downloaded source packages are in
     '/tmp/Rtmpsv9OtD/downloaded_packages'
Warning message:
In install.packages("Matrix") :
   installation of package 'Matrix' had non-zero exit status

Thank you very much.

Best regards,

ya
